guide.title: App User Guide
guide.subtitle: Get to know all sections of Sherpider-Study
guide.dashboard: An overview of your study status, timer, and today's tasks.
guide.timetable: Enter your weekly school or university classes here to always keep them in sight.
guide.homework: Register assignments with dates, times, and priority levels, and check them off when done.
guide.tasks: List your daily and personal tasks to maintain better order in your schedule.
guide.exams: Record exam dates so you never miss a deadline.
guide.timer: Pomodoro timer for focused study. Sessions are automatically saved to your stats.
guide.stats: View your progress charts and stats to understand where your time goes.
guide.calendar: See all events (exams, homework, etc.) at a glance with color coding.
guide.activities: Register and track your extracurricular activities.
guide.flashcards: Review and memorize lessons quickly with 3D cards and a shuffle feature.
guide.game: Warm up your brain before studying with the 'Escape from Distraction' game.
guide.quizzes: Test your knowledge with multiple-choice questions and past Konkur exams.
guide.profile: Edit your name, field, and grade. Change dark mode and app language here too.
